With my arcane prowess growing each day, I am becoming more and more annoyed by the minor nuisances of life; thus, I have devised an incantation capable of spending my body warmth even in the deepest of winters and iciest of deserts. 

I have achieved this by modifying an existing fire affinity spell, which means there is to be had a bit of caution when using this new device; it will also not enhance my capabilities of keeping that warmth. If I don't take the right precautions, it will disperse just as fast as everything else

The scorching rays of the summer sun have taken a toll on my body and mind; thus, I have devised an incantation capable of rapidly dissipating heat from my body into the surrounding area. 

I have achieved this by modifying an existing frost spell, which means there is to be had a bit of caution unless I want to contract frostbite; it will also not decrease my body's natural heat conduction
